name: Taking Care Of Elders
overview: Scripture teaches that honoring and respecting elders is a divine command tied to blessing and reverence for God, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Leviticus 19:32. The wisdom and understanding that come with age are valued, with the aged described as a crown of glory when they walk in righteousness (Job 12:12; Proverbs 16:31). The beauty and strength of old age are to be esteemed, and God’s care for the elderly is emphasized, calling believers not to forsake them in their weakness (Psalms 71:9; Proverbs 20:29). This highlights a Christ-centered duty to care for and honor elders as part of faithful living.
